blocks.text: SAN ILDEFOSO, Ilocos Sur, Philippines — The first sea turtle nest of the season in Bacnotan town, a major nesting site in nearby La Union province, was discovered along the beach in Barangay Pandan on Saturday, Nov. 14, with 112 eggs transferred to a hatchery for protection, according to environmental conservation group Curma. According to Curma, a resident, Arsenio Adev Jr., spotted fresh sea turtle tracks early that morning and promptly reported them to barangay officials.
